name: Beauty and the Thug
source:
By the time she was eighteen, our heroine knew everything about her future. She was the best student in her high school and knew anatomy and physiology like the back of her hand. Being a doctor was her dream, her passion. But everything changed in one moment.

She is now nineteen and had to grow up quickly this past year. She needed a change and has decided to move to the city. But she got into trouble even before reaching her destination. And this episode changes her destiny.

Should Lisa get together with a man who she likes and hates simultaneously? Or it's better to get revenge and get rid of him?

Should Lisa reconnect with her best female friend? Are their feelings much deeper than just a friendship?

Lead Lisa through her life and let her decide what she really wants.

[From [url=https://zegamez.itch.io/beauty-and-the-thug]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
十八岁时，女主人公曾对自己的未来了如指掌。她是高中里最优秀的学生，对解剖学与生理学熟稔于心。成为医生，是她的梦想，也是她满怀热情的追求。然而，一切在一瞬间改变了。

如今她十九岁，过去一年迫使她迅速长大。她需要改变，于是决定搬到城里，却还没抵达目的地就惹上了麻烦。这段插曲改变了她的命运。

丽莎该和那个让自己又爱又恨的男人在一起吗？还是报复他、彻底摆脱他更好？

丽莎该与最好的女性朋友重归于好吗？她们之间的感情，是否远比友情更深？

引导丽莎走过人生，让她决定自己真正想要什么。

[摘自[url=https://zegamez.itch.io/beauty-and-the-thug]Itch.io[/url]]
